fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/tui/inboxapp with a fake runner: a blocker with a 300-character statement renders every word across wrapped lines at the modal's width once opened; a gate row shows its first question's text, and opening it shows each question's text and what each blocks; a blocker on a node whose handle is an ordinary word keeps that word in its question and Blocks line; a test renders every item kind's row, form and detail panel and asserts no handle, ULID or short ID from the items appears.
fields.statement: In the Inbox app a question, blocker or gate row shows its kind, its change set title and the question's restatement (else its full statement) on one line, cut to fit; opening the item shows the question wrapped over as many lines as it needs and what it blocks by title. No row, form or detail panel shows a handle or an ID (item, run, change set or node), and a handle that is an ordinary word stays in the text.
